svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.four-cube-corner-stack-views", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Build the exact four-unit-cube model with origins[(0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), (0, 0, 1)]. Relate the real assembly to three label-free orthographic occupancy views:top at upper left,front below it,right-side at lower right. Worldx goes right in the front view,worldy goes right in the right view,and verticalz goes up;topworldy is drawn up. Each visible unit square is14mm. Unit divisions are projected occupancies,not extra cubes. Unique model count is one only under the declared solid supported-column assumptions;arbitrary hidden-block uniqueness is not claimed. The three assemblies remain distinct under all24proper spatial rotations. Source isometric image is omitted and a real-model teacher activity is essential. No hardware/touch,physical model construction or recognition evaluation performed.", "geometry_exception": "Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm projected boundaries and1mm internal unit divisions. NativeIndex1.2mm graphic dots sample unique14mm unit edges at3.5mm pitch with one logical point per junction. Three panels with at least16mm centreline separation;no hidden edges or isometric view. All alternatives stay in the same master;no exact source reproduction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots,notBraille. Unique unit edges sampled at3.5mm pitch;shared unit boundaries and junction points drawn once. Three separated orthographic panels;actual tactile tracing and orientation recognition pending.
